_comment: Final human-level decisions applied on top of data/groups/research/results by scripts/groups/build-directory.ts. Keys are research record keys (c:<candidate slug> | m:<meetup urlname>). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Decided 2026-09-30.

reject.c:fomo-collective: Grey on the 2026-09-18 review; Matt greenlit only Oklawaha out of the nine grey entries, so the rest stay out.
reject.c:django-jazz-jam-at-sovereign-kava: Grey on the 2026-09-18 review; not greenlit (only Oklawaha was).
reject.c:jacktown-ramblers-bluegrass-jam: Grey on the 2026-09-18 review; not greenlit (only Oklawaha was).
reject.c:appalachian-barn-alliance: Grey on the 2026-09-18 review; not greenlit, and our only events are a benefit someone else hosted for them.
reject.c:next-gen: Grey on the 2026-09-18 review; not greenlit, and research found nothing beyond YMI listings.

merge._comment: source key -> main key. The source's match keys move onto the main group; its listing text is dropped. These take precedence over research duplicate_of for any key they mention.

not_duplicates._comment: duplicate_of suggestions from research that are wrong; these stay separate groups.
not_duplicates.c:asheville-swing-night: Monthly dance at Haw Creek Commons, a different group from Swing Asheville's Monday classes; the 2026-09-18 normalization kept them apart on purpose.
not_duplicates.c:seekhealing-blipoc-support-group: Its own support community under the SeekHealing umbrella, listed separately like The Men's Nest.

edits._comment: Per-key field overrides, applied last. meetup_url: null = the Meetup group was deleted (its page says "Group not found", checked 2026-10-01); the listing stays, per the keep-dormant-groups rule.
